scope: Apply the exact built-in runtime-type/public-tag contract to the public dxfRW::writeMesh and dxfRW::writeHelix entry points.

implementation.failureBehavior: The low-level writer rejects a derived runtime object before typed record emission and leaves the existing destination unchanged.
implementation.retryBehavior: The same dxfRW writer accepts an exact built-in object on retry.

validationProfile.source: A locally authored dx_iface test callback invokes each public low-level writer directly with derived classes carrying extra unmodeled state, then with exact built-in MESH/HELIX objects.
assertions: All direct MESH/HELIX subclass cases are rejected atomically across both encodings.
Each rejection preserves a pre-existing destination sentinel.
Same-writer retry with exact DRW_Mesh reads back the triangle vertices and face indices.
Same-writer retry with exact DRW_Helix reads back the runtime type, fit points, and selected helix fields.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; adapter and direct-writer subclass refusal/retry/readback controls across ASCII and Binary DXF, 0.60 seconds.
validation.fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.

limitations: The tests establish generated serializer admission and transport only, not physical DWG producer breadth or native 3D meaning.
They do not qualify complete MESH subdivision semantics, HELIX curve equivalence, whole-document graph closure, ABI behavior, or 3D consumer acceptance.
P8 remains open and no support claim is promoted.
